title: fix(console): a refused edit-form record read says a localized line, never the response body
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSd2nbuE4y8yizmVhooNYQU)_

Fixes #29186

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:控制台编辑表单(`/forms/NAME?recordId=ID`)读取记录被拒时,横幅不再显示「Could not open record "ID" of OBJECT for editing (403): {…}」,改为一句本地化的话:无读权限(403 / `PERMISSION_DENIED`)显示「您没有权限查看这条记录。」,404 显示「这条记录不存在,或者您没有权限查看它。」(行级安全把看不见的行也答成 404,两者不可区分),其他失败显示「无法打开这条记录,请重试。」。
- **为什么改**:没有读权限的成员打开编辑链接,看到的是英文 JSON,还暴露了记录 id 和对象机器名;#29019 已修好提交路径,加载路径还没有。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 `FormPage.tsx` 的加载失败分支,复用 #29184 的 `WriteRefusal` / `refusalText` / `refusalContent`;十个语言包各加三个 `form` 键(`@object-ui/i18n` 的发布面因此变宽,声明行按席位修正为 `yes (widening)`,changeset 仍为 patch)。回滚即还原此 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` 中 `refusalText` 的 `verb === 'Load'` 分支和加载器的 `throw new WriteRefusal('Load', …)`;`FormPage.loadRefusal-29186.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.loadRefusal-29186.test.tsx`,预期 6 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`, the ten i18n packs, tests and a changeset:

- **The load throws the refusal the submit throws.** The `recordId` branch of `loadInternalForm` no longer builds `Could not open record "ID" of OBJECT for editing (STATUS): BODY`. It throws `new WriteRefusal('Load', status, body)`: the parser PR #29184 added for writes, its verb widened to `'Load'` and kept on the error as `verb`. No second parser. The raw body stays on `.body` for a debugger.
- **`refusalText` reads a load on its own three lines,** before any write rule, and never the server's text:
  1. a `404` as `form.recordNotFoundOrHidden`, asked first, so a 404 whose text happens to name an access rule still reads as not-found-or-hidden (the text-sniffing `isPermissionError` would otherwise tell the two apart);
  2. any other denial (`403`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `FORBIDDEN`) as `form.noPermissionToOpenRecord`;
  3. anything else as `form.openRecordFailed`.
  `form.noPermissionToSave` is not used for a load.
- **The loader's catch** sends a `WriteRefusal` through `refusalText`; every other load error keeps its message (the object-mismatch and blank-id refusals are unchanged).
- **Three new keys** in all ten packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh): "You don't have access to this record.", "This record doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.", "Could not open this record. Please try again."

## Measurement (showcase, before and after)

`examples/app-showcase` on `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, Console source on Vite, a member created by the admin (default member permission set). The before leg served `origin/main`'s `FormPage.tsx` from the same Vite; restored after, blob equal to HEAD.

| Case | Server answer | Banner before | Banner after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/forms/showcase_contact.form?recordId=ID`, member has no read right on contacts | `403` `{"error":"You do not have permission…","code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","object":"showcase_contact"}` | `Could not open record "ID" of showcase_contact for editing (403): {"error":…,"code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","object":"showcase_contact"}` (at 375 px the JSON runs off the banner) | You don't have access to this record. |
| `/forms/showcase_inquiry.contact?recordId=ID`, the admin's inquiry, hidden from the member by the private OWD (the admin reads it 200) | `404` `{"error":"Record ID not found in showcase_inquiry","code":"RECORD_NOT_FOUND","object":"showcase_inquiry"}` | `Could not open record "ID" of showcase_inquiry for editing (404): {"error":…,"code":"RECORD_NOT_FOUND",…}` | This record doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it. |

A missing id answers the same `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` shape as the hidden row (measured on `showcase_task`), so the one line covers both. Screenshots, desktop and 375 px, before and after, are in the project files under `issue-29186/`.

## Tests

- New `FormPage.loadRefusal-29186.test.tsx` (6 cases; fixtures are the measured bodies): a 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` read shows the denial line, and the page text has no `{`, no status, no record id and no object name, with no form or Submit left behind and no write issued; the same in `zh`; a 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` shows the not-found-or-hidden line; a 404 whose text says "Access denied by row-level security policy" still shows that line; a 500 shows the generic line and not the driver text; a 502 markup page shows the generic line.
- `FormPage.recordId.test.tsx`: its three load-refusal pins asserted the old raw text (`Could not open record "task-404".*404`) and now assert the localized lines; what they guard (an error state, no create form, no write) is unchanged.
- `FormPage.refusalText-29019.test.tsx` (the write refusals) passes unchanged.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `else if (e instanceof WriteRefusal) setError(refusalText(e, null, t));` x1 -> x0, replaced by a banner of the status and the raw body): the new suite went **6/6 red**; restored, blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The load banner keeps no "Go back" control and is the same panel as before; only its text changed.
- Other load errors in `loadInternalForm` (form metadata `Could not load form metadata (STATUS): view/NAME`, the object-mismatch refusal) still draw their developer-facing message. They are outside this card's ruling (the record read); noted for the seat, not filed.

## Verification

Local subset. Head `8b71e4ae` (branch merged with `origin/main` twice, both clean; the second merge brought an unrelated key into the same packs, so the i18n suite and the FormPage suites were re-run there).
